verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents 30 idiomatic official SDKs (13 client-side, 13 server-side, 4 edge), plus a Cloudflare edge SDK and official OpenFeature providers. Community users confirm a mobile client SDK and describe the same download-all-flags-then-stream model used across dozens of components. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that flag evaluation is consistent across SDKs, an enumerated list of supported web/mobile/backend languages, and hands-on corroboration of cross-stack parity.
